## Shared entry

Ada studies the register. Neri waits near the closed folder. "We can decide what to do after we hear the whole story," Ada says.

## Choice wording

**Protect:** Give Neri a chance to speak.
**Challenge:** Demand a full accounting.

## Protect selected

Ada lowers her voice. "I will give you a chance before I tell anyone." Neri exhales. "I owe you a real explanation." They return to the archive together.

## Challenge selected

Ada holds the folder open. "I need an account, not a promise." Neri looks toward the door. "Then ask what you came here to ask." Their alliance feels suddenly uncertain.
